scope: Positions 1 through 500 in the current 2026 Fortune ranking, revisited for reporting-entity resolution and first-party evidence depth rather than repeated primary-industry triage.
boundaries: The Fortune position establishes cohort membership only; it does not prove any AMACS capability.
SEC matching resolves a reporting entity and evidence source, not a production organization profile.
Private, mutual, cooperative, governmental, foreign, and otherwise non-SEC-resolved organizations remain in the review queue and are not forced to a public-company match.
Extracted filing statements and candidate mappings remain taxonomy observations marked not_for_profile_import.
Subsidiary, segment, brand, affiliate, and platform-participant activity must not be attributed directly to the parent without an explicit relationship designation.
